stem: What does the poet suggest about the tree in lines 24 through 30?

options.label: A
options.text: It is nearing the end of its life.

options.label: B
options.text: It was in danger one year during a particularly rainy season.

options.label: C
options.text: It has many descriptions of events carved into its wood.

options.label: D
options.text: It has witnessed many events through the years.
